text:
Samira (CEO): Short executive pulse for the week: two decision points before Friday00PT — (A) final go/no-go for Private GA, (B) adoption of the new 30-day default retention policy. Need owners and quick updates. :sparkles:

Victor (VP Eng): On Private GA: main blocker is KMS onboarding tests for two partners. Ill own a fallback plan using managed keys if a partner misses onboarding. Will post runbook snippet after standup.

Lina (Head of Product): Release notes & admin UX: drafting wording to call out the 30-day default and the telemetry opt-out flow. Also adding an FAQ item about observability impact. Draft link: <https://confluence.redwood/private-ga/notes>.

Abe (Finance): Cost ask: target is 11% hosted unit-cost reduction this quarter. Please list expected impact per lever (batching, quantization, cache TTLs) and an owner for each item by Tue COB. Small table is fine.

Miriam (Security): Security items: 1) retention exceptions need an approver record in audit logs, 2) nightly job to assert no live logs >30 days, 3) quick run of SOC control matrix by Wed. Ill drop the audit-schema in this thread.

Samira (CEO): Owners: Victor (rollout + fallback), Lina (release notes + comms), Abe (cost consolidation), Miriam (security & SOC). Friday 15:00 PT is the go/no-go meeting. If any blocker, ping me directly and mark with `urgent:exec`.

Victor (VP Eng): OpsBot, schedule canary tomorrow 08:45 PT. Include metrics: p95, p99, cold-start-90s, optout-e2e.

OpsBot: Canary scheduled by Victor  build 2026.06.12-rlw-478. Hooks: telemetry-optout, p95,p99, cold-starts.

Lina (Head of Product): UX note: opt-out must not remove platform-level error codes from the admin console. Will confirm with infra that safe-logs are available when opt-out is enabled.

Miriam (Security): Ill run a mock retention-exception approval and post audit-event sample: `event: retention_exception, approver: legal@redwood, duration: 180_days`.

Abe (Finance): Quick win: label perf experiments with cost tags this sprint, ex: `cost:batching`. That will let me backfill numbers.

Victor (VP Eng): Ill post the canary summary to this thread after the 09:30 smoke. If the canary shows >20% p99 regression, we abort.

Samira (CEO): Final: keep comms tight. Two asks before Friday: 1) Victor post canary + fallback approval, 2) Lina post draft release notes. We want a clean decision with owners ready to act. Thanks team. :handshake:
